title: Port batch 2 into the harness so bd replay regenerates its rows
description: The religion and nationality dimensions on the ranked board come from studies/batch2/stereotypes-laya.jsonl, a staged copy that bd replay cannot regenerate, and the pre-registration for batch 2 still reads 'not yet run'. Move the batch 2 answer record into answers/, port its scorer, make bd replay reproduce the rows byte for byte, delete the batch2-staging source, and append the Outcome section to the pre-registration.
